title: How One Standing Call a Week Changes What a Godly Man Actually Confesses
caption:
Isolation doesn't look like an empty room. It looks like a full calendar and nobody who actually knows your week.

A godly man doesn't wait to feel like confessing. He builds the one habit that forces it: a standing call, same night every week, with one man who won't let him dodge.

Save this for the week you're most tempted to cancel it.
